== Summary ==
A beer hall table on 27 September 2018, during the trip after the [[2018 European Championship]] (Bochum, Germany, 21–23 September 2018). Posted in reply to an Oktoberfest photograph ("That place looks familiar!").

* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2020-01-16
* '''Camera date:''' 2018-09-27
* '''Identification:''' the post names nobody; faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]].
